title: Grateful Dead Live at Honolulu Civic Auditorium on 1970-01-24
lineage: SBD: MC > cassette > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a short, mellow Hawaii show highlighted by a stellar Mason's Children and standout Cumberland Blues
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the clean, crisp soundboard capture of this brief January‑1970 Honolulu set, noting its sweet mix and minimal tape noise. Musically the performance shines with a slower, soulful Me & My Uncle, a fierce King Bee, and what many call the best version of Mason's Children, while the overall flow is described as island‑friendly and mellow.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments on both performance (standout songs, strong playing) and recording quality (clean, crisp soundboard), with only minor notes of drop‑outs/pitch issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleanest Mason's Children found; crisp mix throughout. A few reviewers note occasional SBD drop‑outs and a slight pitch correction needed, but overall the tape sounds superb for 1970.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short single‑set show with a mellow, island‑friendly flow; tight pacing despite limited runtime, highlighted by strong pigpen finale and cohesive jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for impressive phrasing on Black Peter, best Hawaiian guitar work, a slower Me & My Uncle, and solid dancing on Mason's Children.
band_member_comments.Bob: String break noted during Me & My Uncle but otherwise not highlighted.
